# Synthetic LuFe/Mn/O Corpus Pilot Fixture

This fixture is synthetic and sanitized. It contains no copyrighted paper text, no PDF, no figure image, no raw BT-7 data, and no generated real-data artifact.

It exists to test document-side corpus ingestion, typed evidence graph edges, source-support validation, and retrieval over paper chunks, figure panels, candidate source links, and textbook/review chunks.
